name: Riviera Joyas
description: Uruguayan online store selling watches such as Seiko, Orient, Citizen, Tissot and Casio, and gold, silver and plated jewelry, with prices in USD. Delivers in Montevideo and the interior by UES and offers pickup points in two Montevideo shopping centers.
description_es: Tienda en línea uruguaya de relojes como Seiko, Orient, Citizen, Tissot y Casio, y joyas de oro, plata y enchapadas, con precios en USD. Envía en Montevideo y al interior por UES y ofrece retiro en dos shoppings de Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo up to 48 business hours and interior about 48 to 72 business hours via UES, per the store's shipping page

fulfillment.pickup_notes: PickUp points at Punta Carretas Shopping and Nuevocentro Shopping, per the shipping page
